blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Health (DOH) on Tuesday warned the public against individuals posing as Health Secretary Edwin Mercado to solicit donations. The DOH said it received reports of messages from people introducing themselves as Mercado. READ: DOH warns public vs counterfeit medicines, vaccines “DOH clarifies that any messages or calls requesting donations or transactions using the Secretary’s name are unofficial and untrue,” the agency said. “The public is reminded to be cautious and not contact, give money, or transact with suspicious accounts, numbers, or messages,” it added.
